title: ONS suspends surplus power generation for the second time this year
seoTitle: ONS suspends surplus power generation for 2nd time
subtitle: National Electric System Operator triggers emergency plan to reduce energy production
excerpt: For the second time this year, ONS has triggered an emergency plan to reduce energy generation amid oversupply in the System.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The National Electric System Operator (ONS) has triggered, for the second time this year, an emergency plan to reduce energy generation in response to an oversupply in System I.

The activation of the emergency plan aims to balance energy production with demand, preventing overloads and potential failures in the electrical grid.

ONS will continue to monitor the situation and implement additional measures if the oversupply persists.

With information from Agência Brasil.
